title: ‘AI Maker, Not an AI Taker’: UK Builds Its Vision With NVIDIA Infrastructure
description: U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s ambition for Britain to be an “AI maker, not an AI taker,” is becoming a reality at London Tech Week. With NVIDIA’s support, the U.K. is building sovereign compute infrastructure, investing in cutting-edge research and skills, and fostering AI leadership across sectors.
